items.title: Union Pacific Sees Norfolk Southern Merger Closing by Late 2027 as STB Review Advances
items.summary: Union Pacific (NYSE:UNP) executives said the company is moving into the merits phase of federal review for its proposed merger with Norfolk Southern, expressing confidence that the transaction will satisfy Surface Transportation Board requirements and create customer, safety and financial benefits.
